description: Sanctions wallet screen — OFAC Digital Currency Address. Exact-match a blockchain address against Digital Currency Address identifiers published in the OFAC SDN XML (the same Treasury list we ingest for name screens). CLEAR or HIT. No third-party chain intel, no clustering, no risk score. $0.01 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.
